content_metadata.description: This vlog-style video captures Matthew Meagher's exciting journey to the NFL Draft, thanks to Subway's VIP experience. The narrative centers around his interactions with draft prospects, celebrities, and fans, culminating in his memorable announcement of a draft pick. The video combines humor, gratitude, and a sense of achievement, showcasing the thrilling experience of being a part of the NFL Draft festivities.
